title: DP-FinDiff
summary: A PyTorch framework extending FinDiff with differential privacy to generate privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data for mixed continuous/categorical financial datasets. Its example notebook imports sdv.metadata.SingleTableMetadata and sdv.evaluation.single_table to build a metadata schema and run SDV's quality/diagnostic reports for evaluating the generated synthetic data.
